svg.title: The hidden layer re-draws the paper
svg.desc: Four frames: the four XOR points on a unit square with three dashed red straight lines that each misclassify a point, the same square with two deliberate lines h1 and h2 drawn on it, the same four points re-plotted in h1-h2 coordinates where the two positive points land on top of each other and one green line separates them, and the resulting two-input two-hidden-unit network with weights plus one, biases minus 0.5 and minus 1.5 and a minus-one output edge, nine parameters in all, beside a crossed-out no-activation version that collapses back to one line.
svg.text: The hidden layer re-draws the paper
try it. Every straight line gets one
